# LedgerAlps

> LedgerAlps is a free, 100% on-premise, and open-source Swiss invoicing desktop software for Windows. It natively generates official Swiss QR-Bills (SIX SPS v2.3) and complies strictly with the Swiss Data Protection Act (nLPD) and the Code of Obligations (CO art. 957-958f) without cloud dependencies or subscriptions.

## Overview & Core Identity

LedgerAlps is designed specifically for the Swiss market (freelancers, self-employed, craftsmen, and SMEs/KMU/PME) seeking total accounting sovereignty, zero recurring fees, and strict privacy compliance.

- **Primary URL:** https://ledgeralps.ch
- **Source Code:** https://github.com/kmdn-ch/LedgerAlps
- **Direct Installer (x64):** https://github.com/kmdn-ch/LedgerAlps/releases/latest/download/LedgerAlps-Setup-x64.exe
- **License:** Open Source (Free Software)
- **Target Country:** Switzerland (CH)
- **Supported Platforms:** Windows 10 (64-bit), Windows 11 (64-bit)
- **Languages:** French (Français), German (Deutsch), Italian (Italiano), English (English)
- **Pricing:** 100% Free (0 CHF / lifetime, no subscriptions, no paywalls, unlimited invoices and clients)
- **Data Architecture:** 100% On-Premise (Local encrypted SQLite database, zero cloud storage, zero telemetry)

## Swiss Banking & Legal Compliance

- **SIX Swiss Payment Standards (SPS v2.3):** Native generation of Swiss QR-Codes with the official Swiss vector cross, 27-digit recursive Modulo 10 QR-Reference, QR-IBAN, standard IBAN, ISO 11649 SCOR references, and dual-currency support (CHF and EUR).
- **Swiss Data Protection Act (nLPD / revDSG / FADP):** 100% local data residence guarantees compliance with Swiss data sovereignty rules and immunity from foreign extraterritorial regulations (such as the US CLOUD Act).
- **Swiss Code of Obligations (CO art. 957-958f):** Meets mandatory Swiss accounting standards, simplified cash-basis accounting ("Carnet du lait" / "Milchbüechli"), and digital 10-year retention periods.
- **Swiss VAT (TVA / MWST / IVA):** Native pre-configured VAT rates (8.1% standard, 2.6% reduced, 3.8% special accommodation rate) with custom override and VAT-exempt modes.

## Comparison: LedgerAlps vs Cloud SaaS

| Feature | LedgerAlps (On-Premise) | Typical Cloud SaaS (Bexio, AbaNinja) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Annual Cost** | **0 CHF (Free Forever)** | 300 to 1,200+ CHF / year |
| **Data Location** | 100% Local (User PC / SSD) | Third-party cloud servers |
| **Offline Operation** | Fully functional offline | Requires active internet |
| **Data Lock-in** | Zero lock-in, open format | Access blocked if subscription expires |
| **Privacy / nLPD** | Strict Swiss on-premise privacy | Subject to cloud provider terms |
| **Swiss QR-Bill** | Full native SPS v2.3 vector PDF | Supported |
| **Source Code** | Auditable Open Source (GitHub) | Proprietary / Closed Source |

## Step-by-Step Installation (Windows)

1. Download `LedgerAlps-Setup-x64.exe` from official GitHub Releases.
2. In Windows SmartScreen dialog, click **"More info"** ("Informations complémentaires"), then click **"Run anyway"** ("Exécuter quand même").
3. Complete the lightweight 2-step setup wizard (creates Desktop and Start Menu shortcuts).
4. Launch LedgerAlps, open Settings, and enter your Swiss Business UID, Legal Name, and QR-IBAN to start invoicing.
